pop.aboutTxt: A simple mod launcher for RMB-based Incredibox mods.
pop.howToTxt: In "resources/mods/", create a folder with the name of your mod. Inside, add a "src/" folder for the mod's files (which should be extracted from "resources/app/src"). Also include "icon.png" for the mod icon, "banner.png" for the banner, and a "mod.json" with the mod's metadata (name, author, version, description, etc.). Then, open the launcher and search for your mod. If you did everything correctly, the mod should be installed. In case you update any of the mod's files, you can refresh the mod so it actually updates. To go back to the launcher at anytime, press F1.
